castAddBody.text:
dkm

am coding with nearly-free open-weights models

>6 months after ppl said sota models were good enough

to stop reading code

(if you do it the right way)

on mildly challenging but highly annoying tasks

with clear prompting, adversarial review

I still end up cleaning up after them manually

here's an example. Upgrading a project from TS6 to TS7

agents did 99% of the work

just a step above grunt work, but requires some context of the project

my IDE flagged an issue, after passing tests and strict linting

multiple agent passes had left behind low-hanging tech debt

that was trivial to address

and well-documented

maybe that's the point, humans over-clean? easy tech debt should be left for a cheaper future???
